blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nickel Asia Corp. (NAC) reported a 19-percent jump in its nine-month income, lifted by higher metal prices and sales as well as a booming renewable energy business. The listed miner’s attributable net income rose to ₱6.16 billion from ₱5.19 billion a year earlier. READ: Nickel Asia books 93% higher H1 profit “Our strong nine-month results reflect solid execution across our operations and a nickel market supported by tighter ore supply conditions in Indonesia.
